text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Oyo? If it isn't Espo~ Did you come to 
check out the new shoes too?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Everyone's talking about how crazy the 
bounce is on sandy ground~. You've already 
got your eye on it? As expected of Espo-n!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
…………Tch. Shut up, I won't know till I 
actually try using it!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
! Uh-oh, someone's in a huff. Hmm... maybe 
she's just embarrassed?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Espo-san, you're just way too amazing...! 
You were so powerful, I couldn't take my 
eyes off you~~!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
You've been especially amazing lately! Are 
you doing anything special to improve your 
movement?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
S-Shut up! I told you there's nothin' like 
that going on!!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, hey, what's gotten into you 
lately? Your qi flow is perfect! Word is 
your running and dancing are sharper than 
ever~!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Gaaah, seriously, not you too!! Cut it 
out! It's not really anything—

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Why the hell do I need you telling me what 
shoes to wear?!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"Change your workout," "do more 
stretches"... Don't get cocky just 'cause 
you're my Trainer! If this doesn't work, 
I'm gonna beat you to a pulp, got it?!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Ngggh, it's nothin'! Like hell this is 
thanks to that guy!!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Eh, what!? Espo-san, where are you going!?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"Shut up! They told me to drink water 
before bed! I'm gonna prove it's pointless 
this time!"
